evals.name: find-released-uuid-api
evals.prompt: In ABAP for Cloud Development, what released class can I use to generate a UUID, and can you show a short example?
evals.expected_output: Identifies CL_SYSTEM_UUID as a released option and provides a concise UUID-generation example without suggesting an unreleased API.

evals.name: route-wrapper-for-unreleased-api
evals.prompt: The class I need is not released for ABAP Cloud. Explain the wrapper approach and how that affects clean core classification; don't search for a different released class.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the primary question is the ABAP Cloud wrapper pattern and clean-core classification and routes to the abap-cloud skill instead of inventing a released status or listing unrelated classes.
